provenance.title: Relief items and standards
provenance.licence: Item names are the exercise's own; standards summarise the Sphere Handbook
provenance.note: Sphere indicators are minimums for planning, read alongside the full handbook.

records.name: Drinking and domestic water
records.standard: Sphere: at least 15 L per person per day for drinking, cooking and hygiene.

records.name: Water bowser
records.standard: Record the tank size in the stock notes.

records.name: Water purification tablets
records.standard: Follow the product dose per litre.

records.name: Dry ration pack
records.standard: Sphere: 2,100 kcal per person per day. Pack contents follow the issuing agency's list (exercise definition).

records.name: Cooking utensil set
records.standard: One per household or communal kitchen (exercise planning note).

records.name: Tarpaulin
records.standard: Sphere: covered living space of at least 3.5 m² per person.

records.name: Family tent
records.standard: Sphere: covered living space of at least 3.5 m² per person.

records.name: Sleeping mat
records.standard: Sphere: a sleeping mat or mattress for each person.

records.name: Blanket
records.standard: Sphere: a blanket for each person; more in cold areas.

records.name: Mosquito net
records.standard: One per sleeping space where mosquito-borne disease is a risk (exercise planning note).

records.name: Hygiene kit
records.standard: Sphere: 250 g bathing soap and 200 g laundry soap per person per month.

records.name: First-aid kit
records.standard: One per centre at least (exercise planning note).

records.name: Generator
records.standard: Record the kVA rating in the stock notes.

records.name: Inflatable rescue boat
records.standard: Crew and life jackets go with each boat.

records.name: Passenger bus
records.standard: Record the seat count in the stock notes.

records.name: Helicopter
records.standard: Record type, seats and hoist in the stock notes; tasking stays with the Air Force.

records.name: Search and rescue team
records.standard: Record team size and skills (swift water, collapse, medical) in the notes.
